svg.data-capacity-scope: the load the PDU can hand on (40 A at 208 V three phase), from the SKU title; it is not what the PDU draws itself, which no document held states
svg.data-output-rating: 10 A per C13, 16 A per C39, 16 A per section, 40 A per phase
svg.data-metering: current, power and energy for the input and each outlet; current for each branch
svg.data-network-module: G4 eNMC, dual gigabit Ethernet with network cascading
svg.data-emc: FCC part 15 class A, CAN ICES-003 class A
